cases.note: Under `read: fresh`: SharePoint rewrites an uploaded Office file, so the write's bytes carry no token and the next read downloads the rewritten file. Under `bounded` the bytes sent are served until the mount's ttl.

scenario.command: mkdir -p /data/office && eval 'printf slide-bytes | tee /data/office/nested.pptx > /dev/null && cat /data/office/nested.pptx'; echo; cat /data/office/nested.pptx
